supports: On this fixed NVDA Item 1A pair, protocol and input treatment materially change usefulness, specificity, novelty separation, and auditability.
The primary read is the clearest first read because it combines a bounded structured contract with paragraph-addressable tagged evidence.
Holding the tagged substrate fixed shows that protocol changes alone can materially alter the lead story and the organization of evidence.
A bounded Fresh vs reused view now transfers across vivid and restraint cases without promoting it to an equal top-level read.
does_not_yet_support: This is a bounded case view and does not yet generalize across companies or establish a benchmark-grade leaderboard.
It is not a final proof of universal superiority of one protocol outside the fixed filing pair and current visible pilot mix.
It does not yet cover whole-filing context, external research overlays, broad issuer expansion, or equal-weight promotion of Fresh vs reused.
why_02_is_hero: The primary read stays first because it best surfaces what changed in NVDA while keeping the output structured, specific, and easy to audit against the tagged packet.
why_03_is_main_comparator: The comparison read uses the same i2 tagged substrate as the primary read, making protocol framing the main variable under comparison.
why_00_is_control: The control read uses the same tagged substrate as the primary read without the canonical structured contract, and its recovered status keeps the baseline honest.
why_01_is_secondary: The secondary comparison is useful but less audit-rich than the i2 tagged runs and therefore not the best opening pass.
